BTC/USDT.excl_best_method: starting_balance * product(1 + profit_ratio) over every trade except the one with the highest profit_ratio, minus starting_balance (compounded; NOT total profit minus the best trade's profit_abs, because with a whole-balance stake the best trade also enlarges every later trade)
